modules.policy: Single-root modules/packages; local from-import names share a provider search. Child searches use the same budget. Explicit standard model bindings each use one lookup and require absent local candidates. Proved missing sibling imports may select literal metadata handlers. Unused plain module attribute hooks defer; required missing-member hooks stay unchecked. Cycles require available names in execution order. Supported future directives need absent local __future__ candidates. Imported non-entry modules may omit one exact main guard without other __name__ uses or alternatives. Dynamic imports, merged namespaces and search paths stay unchecked.

standard_library.boundary: Standard CPython library and builtins, scalar arguments and immutable dates; no replacement import hooks, monkey patching, overloaded protocols or implicit exception model.
standard_library.calls: Scalar abs/int/float/str/bool/round and multi-argument min/max; ValueError/TypeError construction in raise; math scalar functions and datetime.date. The re namespace supplies references; its calls remain unchecked.
standard_library.imports: Explicit selected standard modules; competing local source, package, stub, directory, bytecode and extension candidates must be absent, including transitive standard-library names.

string_methods.receiver: Plain str from literals, checked str conversions, local bindings and normal helper summaries; annotations do not establish runtime types.
